landing.hero.title: Government credentials, held by the citizen and verified in seconds.
landing.hero.body: CiviLedger lets authorities issue digital credentials, lets citizens hold them and choose what to share, and lets any verifier confirm authenticity and revocation status on the spot. Personal data stays off the ledger; only proofs go on it.
landing.hero.imageAlt: A man in Bangladesh checks his phone while standing in an open green field.
landing.how.imageAlt: A graduate smiles and holds up a diploma certificate toward the camera.
landing.cta.title: Built for the people who issue, hold, and check credentials every day.
landing.cta.body: A prototype today, designed for a real academic-credential pilot with Bangladeshi institutions next.
landing.cta.imageAlt: People walk along a busy street in Dhaka during the day.
landing.what.heading: Trust between institutions, without a central database
landing.what.tamperproof.title: Tamper-evident by design
landing.what.tamperproof.body: Every credential is anchored on the ledger as a cryptographic hash. Change one character of the underlying document and the hash no longer matches.
landing.what.citizen.title: The citizen decides
landing.what.citizen.body: Credentials live in the citizen's wallet. They choose which one to present, to whom, and for how long. No authority sees a share it did not receive.
landing.what.instant.title: Answered in seconds
landing.what.instant.body: A verifier checks the issuer, the signature, the status, and the expiry against the ledger directly. No phone calls, no waiting on a paper copy.
landing.how.heading: Four steps, start to finish
landing.how.issue.title: Issue
landing.how.issue.body: An authority verifies its own record and anchors the credential's hash and status on the ledger.
landing.how.hold.title: Hold
landing.how.hold.body: The citizen receives the full credential in their CiviLedger wallet and keeps it off the ledger.
landing.how.share.title: Share
landing.how.share.body: The citizen generates a time-limited link or QR code for one specific verifier.
landing.how.verify.title: Verify
landing.how.verify.body: The verifier opens the link and gets a checked result, with the transactions to inspect.
landing.roles.heading: Choose how you're using CiviLedger
landing.roles.institution.title: An institution
landing.roles.institution.body: Issue and manage credentials for citizens.
landing.roles.citizen.title: A citizen
landing.roles.citizen.body: View the credentials you hold and share them.
landing.roles.verifier.title: A verifier
landing.roles.verifier.body: Confirm a credential someone has shared with you.
landing.arch.heading: How the pieces fit
landing.arch.body: Four layers. The client is one app with a view per role. The application layer holds the off-chain database and bridges to the chain. The blockchain layer runs the five governance and credential contracts.
landing.arch.split: Only hashes, status, consent events, and governance events are written on-chain. Names, documents, and anything that must be correctable stay in the off-chain store.

verify.title: Verification result
verify.subtitle: Checking this presentation against the blockchain.
verify.recordedBody: A verification receipt was written on-chain.
verify.verdictHint.VALID: Every check passed. This credential is authentic and active.
verify.verdictHint.REVOKED: The issuing authority has revoked this credential.
verify.verdictHint.SUSPENDED: The issuing authority has temporarily suspended this credential.
verify.verdictHint.EXPIRED: This credential has passed its expiry date.
verify.verdictHint.HASH_MISMATCH: The shared credential does not match what was anchored on-chain. Do not accept it.
verify.verdictHint.ISSUER_NOT_TRUSTED: The address that issued this credential is not a currently-active registered authority.
verify.verdictHint.ANCHOR_NOT_FOUND: No matching record exists on-chain for this credential.
verify.verdictHint.NOT_ANCHORED: This credential was never anchored on-chain and cannot be verified.
verify.verdictHint.STATUS_UNKNOWN: The on-chain status could not be read. Try again shortly.
verify.verdictHint.CHAIN_UNREACHABLE: The blockchain node could not be reached, so this credential could not be verified. Try again shortly.
verify.checkDetail.hash.match: The shared credential matches the hash anchored on-chain.
verify.checkDetail.hash.mismatch: The shared credential does not match the on-chain hash.
verify.checkDetail.issuer.active: Issued by {issuer}, a registered and active authority.
verify.checkDetail.issuer.inactive: The issuing address is not a currently-active registered authority.
verify.checkDetail.status.suspended: The issuer has suspended this credential.
verify.checkDetail.status.revoked: The issuer has revoked this credential.
verify.checkDetail.status.unknown: The on-chain status could not be read.
verify.checkDetail.expiry.none: This credential has no expiry date.

verify.error.expired: This share link has expired. Ask the citizen to generate a new one.
